title: Make a complaint about a NSW Government agency
summary: If you have an issue with a NSW government agency, you should first contact the agency directly. If that fails, you can submit a complaint to the NSW Ombudsman.
intro:
If you have an issue with a NSW government agency the first step is to contact them and try to resolve the matter.

If you’re unable to resolve your issue or if you do not feel safe making a complaint to the agency, you can submit a form to the NSW Ombudsman online.

The NSW Ombudsman:
who_can_apply: You must have already contacted the NSW agency you are complaining about.
what_you_need: The name of the NSW agency your complaint is about
Details of what happened after you contacted the agency
How you see the complaint being resolved
Up to 3 documents of evidence to support your complaint (such as correspondence with the agency)

how_to_steps.text: Check if the NSW Ombudsman can handle your complaint.
Follow the prompts to complete the form.

more_info.text: The NSW Ombudsman cannot help with complaints about Centrelink (Services Australia), Australian Tax Office (ATO), electricity, gas, water and phone companies, and other private businesses.

faqs.q: What should I do if I have an issue with a NSW government agency?
faqs.a: The first step is to contact the agency directly and try to resolve the matter. If you cannot resolve the issue or do not feel safe making a complaint to the agency, you can submit a form to the NSW Ombudsman online.

faqs.q: Who can use the online complaints form?
faqs.a: You can use the online complaints form if you have already contacted the NSW agency you are making the complaint about.

faqs.q: Where can I check if the NSW Ombudsman can handle my complaint?
faqs.a: You can check if the NSW Ombudsman can handle your complaint using the link: https://www.ombo.nsw.gov.au/complaints/complaints-we-can-help-you-with
